editorial:
Ever wonder what it would be like to have the President as a dad? You get to see that world through Anna, a girl who is tired of having Secret Service agents follow her every move. When her family takes a trip to Europe, she decides she has had enough and ditches her guards to explore the cities on her own. It is a lighthearted ride that feels like a vacation, blending a cute romance with a bit of chaos. You will love the vibe of the European streets and the feeling of freedom as she tries to act like a normal teenager for the first time in her life.

The chemistry between the leads is the best part, even if the plot is a bit predictable. While it is not a deep drama, it moves quickly and keeps you smiling. If you want something easy to watch on a lazy Sunday, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: At the end, Anna discovers that the guy she fell in love with was actually working for her father the whole time. Even though she feels tricked, he proves his feelings for her are real. They make up, and Anna finds a better balance between her duties as the First Daughter and her own happiness. It wraps up with a sweet romantic moment, showing that she can have both her freedom and her love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute rom-coms and stories about breaking the rules.
